lines.text: Many learners say: I ate medicine this morning.
Better: I took medicine this morning.
Took! I took medicine this morning.

native.tip: 약은 eat이 아니라 take! “I took medicine”이에요.
native.caption: “I ate medicine this morning”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 약을 먹는다고 할 때는 eat 대신 take를 써요. “I took medicine this morning”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “took”. 약 먹기는 take! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: For medicine, use take, not eat. Say “I took medicine”.
en.caption: Do you say “I ate medicine this morning”? 😅 We use “take” for medicine, not “eat”. “I took medicine this morning” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
